# Notion fields, per database

<!-- Generated by `pnpm hub docs` from app/projects/_template/notion-crm/schema/*.json. Do not edit; change the schema file instead. -->

Every property of every database the Notion CRM deploys, with its type, who writes it and the select options. Names are exactly as Notion shows them: Hub and the CRM sync look fields up by name, so never rename one. The meaning and the rules behind a module are in the pack's markdown (`02` to `07`); how to set Notion up is in [`README.md`](README.md).

**Writer** says who may change the field: `Hub` (the local app), `CRM` or `sync` (the Django CRM), `people` (a person by hand), `agent` (a workflow, after the owner's OK), `agent and people` (the client profile: the agent keeps it current from what the client says, the owner may edit). One owner per field. A field with a `Description` has it synced to the live database by `hub install --only notion.descriptions`.

## Databases

- [Bug reports](#bug-reports) (`bug-reports`, 17 fields)
- [Business contacts](#business-contacts) (`business-contacts`, 18 fields)
- [Clients](#clients) (`clients`, 49 fields)
- [Deals](#deals) (`deals`, 44 fields)

## Bug reports

Pack file: `schema/bug-reports.json`.

| Field | Type | Writer | Options and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bug | title | agent | Description: "The symptom in one line, in the client's terms. Written by the Hub's bug_report tool; people may edit." Never a cause: a cause is people's, in Notes. |
| Projects | multi_select | agent | Description: "The project keys this report belongs to (decision 0053), the same options as Clients Projects." Options are the `## Brands` rows; `notion.projects` keeps them in step. |
| Clients | relation to clients | agent | Description: "Every client who reported this bug. A second client with the same symptom is added here, never filed again." Several; one-way (Clients gets no reverse property). |
| Channel | select | agent | Options: Mail, WhatsApp, Telegram, Other. |
| Source link | url | agent | Description: "Where the first report was made: the conversation in the Hub admin. Written by the tool from the conversation, never typed by the agent." |
| Client's words | text | agent | Description: "The client's own sentence, quoted (at most 1,500 characters). Later reports are appended to the page body, dated." |
| Evidence | text | agent | Description: "One line per URL, id or screenshot reference the client gave. Only what the client sent or the agent saw." |
| Kind | select | agent | Description: "Product: our product misbehaves. Knowledge gap: a client asked what the knowledge base does not answer (or only in general). Workflow: the agent could not resolve something itself (a refusal with no path, a lead it could not classify, a missing or contradictory record). Empty is Product." Options: Product, Knowledge gap, Workflow. P147 3g. The open-report search keys on Kind plus Area, so a recurring gap is one row with many Clients. |
| Area | select | agent | Description: "<kind>: <name>, lower case (parser: <source>, site: <domain>, api, admin; for a Knowledge gap the topic, knowledge: <topic>; for Workflow the step, workflow: <tool or step>). An option is reused when its normalised form matches." The open-report search keys on Area and Projects. |
| Status | select | people | Description: "The agent sets New only; people move it on. A select, not a Status: the API cannot create a Status." Options: New, Triaged, In progress, Fixed, Won't fix, Duplicate. Fixed with an empty Client told makes the next follow-up sweep draft a short "fixed, please check" note for each linked client (P145 B4); Client told is written once every one of them was told. |
| Severity | select | people | Description: "Set by people at triage; empty until then. The agent never writes it." Options: Critical, High, Normal, Low. |
| Duplicate of | relation to bug-reports | people | Description: "The report this one repeats (Status Duplicate)." |
| Reported at | date | agent | Description: "When the first report's message was sent." |
| Last reported | date | agent | Description: "When the latest report was appended." |
| Client told | date | Hub | Description: "When the clients were told it is fixed: set by the Hub at the send of the "fixed" message. Do not edit." Written once every linked client the sweep noted was told, with the last send's time. |
| Fix link | url | people | Description: "The commit, pull request or task that fixed it." |
| Notes | text | people | Description: "People's notes, the cause among them. The agent never writes here." |

## Clients

Pack file: `schema/clients.json`.

| Field | Type | Writer | Options and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Name | title | agent and people | Description: "Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit." The person's real name, plus the company (Ahmed, Qimma Auctions). A Hub write replaces only an empty title, an address, a phone number or a chat id, never a real name (P140 P1b). |
| Email | email | agent and people | Description: "Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit." The Hub's link key: filled when empty, never cleared or replaced; a second address goes to Other emails (P140 P1b). |
| Other emails | text | people |  |
| Phone | phone_number | agent and people | Description: "Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit." |
| Telegram | text | people | Description: "Edited by people. Telegram username without @ (e.g. anna_k) or a phone in +E.164. The Hub links this person's Telegram chat to the client when it matches exactly one client." Read by the Hub's messenger autolink (P84). |
| WhatsApp | phone_number | people | Description: "Edited by people. WhatsApp number in +E.164 (country code first), only when it differs from Phone. The Hub matches WhatsApp chats against Phone and this field." Read by the Hub's messenger autolink (P84). |
| Gmail | url | CRM |  |
| Drive folder | url | people |  |
| Relationship | select | agent and people | Description: "Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit." Options: Lead, Prospect, Client, Partner, Other. |
| Activity | select | CRM | Options: Active, Quiet, Dormant, Lapsed. |
| Grade | select | human | Options: Priority, Standard, Low. |
| Type | select | agent and people | Description: "Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit." Options: Agent/Broker, CBI agent, Lawyer, Banker/Lender, Accountant/Tax, Developer, Service provider, Media, Colleague, Other. generic: drop Agent/Broker, CBI agent |
| Lead source | select | agent and people | Description: "Kept current by the agent from what the client says (never invented); the owner may edit." Options: Partner brokerage, Resort partner, Portal, Own website, Referral, CBI partner, Past client, Event, Outbound, Other. generic: Referral, Past client, Event, Outbound, Other |
| Projects | multi_select | agent and people | Description: "The projects this client is confirmed for (one option per project key; decision 0053). Added by the agent and people on evidence, never removed by the Hub." Confirmed membership (decision 0053). Options are the project's `## Brands` rows (and a project with no brand row, such as a development), matched by project key: lower case, letters and digits only. Strong evidence adds an option: the client wrote to a brand's address, a linked lead carries that Brand, or the client names the product. A weak guess (a mention, a signature, a visited page) is a `Project hint:` line in Conversation summary, never an option. The Hub writes it on a new card and adds the lead's project to a known card it links; it never removes one. `hub install --only notion.projects` keeps the options in step with `## Brands`. |
| Project signals | formula | formula | Formula: the union of Projects, the Brand of every linked Lead except Other, and the project a client's import key or Lead source names (per instance: an External ID prefix such as `<project>:client:`, or a Lead source value that is a site). Read-only, never written by anyone (decision 0053 point 4). The API cannot create a cross-database formula: create it by hand in Notion (`hub doctor --only notion.project-keys` warns while it is missing). Project views filter on it and exclude Synthetic rows; Project unknown is Projects empty AND Project signals empty. A lead counts only once it is linked to the client (P97). Flags: created by hand (the API cannot). |
| Islands | multi_select |  | Options: Region A, Region B, Region C, Other. Flags: vertical. |
| Waiting band | select | CRM | Options: Today, 1-3 days, Up to 2 weeks, Up to a month, Over a month. |
| Waiting since | date | CRM |  |
| Follow-up on | date | CRM |  |
| Last inbound | date | CRM |  |
| Last outbound | date | CRM |  |
| Last two-way contact | date | CRM |  |
| Last sent at | date | Hub | Description: "Written by the Hub when a reply to this client is sent (its send button or Sent detection). Do not edit." With Last sent by: who of the team last wrote to the client (P89, decision 0043). Not Last outbound, which is the CRM sync's. Flags: optional. |
| Last sent by | text | Hub | Description: "Written by the Hub: the name of the team member whose Hub sent the last reply (their setup name). Do not edit." Project setting notion.stamp_sends (on by default) switches the write (P89). Flags: optional. |
| Next follow-up | date | Hub | P142 (decision 0050): the day the follow-up sweep looks at this client again; emptied when the client answers. Added by `hub install --only notion.follow-ups`. Not Follow-up on, which is the CRM sync's. Flags: optional. |
| Follow-up status | select | Hub | Options: Waiting, Nudge ready, Stopped, Handed over, Answered. P142: the follow-up plan's state (a select: the API cannot create a Status). A dated line per decision is appended under the page's "Follow-ups" heading. Flags: optional. |
| Follow-ups sent | number | Hub | P142: nudges sent since the client last wrote; back to 0 when they answer. Flags: optional. |
| Waiting on | select | Hub | Options: Them, Us. P142: who owes the next message, the agent's reading. Not Waiting since, which is the CRM sync's. Flags: optional. |

| Brand | multi_select | integration (the owner's backend, e.g. django_notion) | Description: "The project key of the lead's origin: the site or product it came from. Written by the integration; options named like the Hub's ## Brands rows." The project key of the lead's origin (decision 0053): which site or product the lead came from. Leads keeps `Brand` (the other databases use `Projects`): the integration writes it (django_notion matches the backend's project key to the option with the same key: lower case, letters and digits only), the silence check filters on it, and Clients' `Project signals` reads it. The options are named like the project's `## Brands` rows; `hub install --only notion.projects` adds a missing one. A missing option leaves Brand empty, never stops the form. One lead can carry several brands; `Other` is no project. |
| Hub decision | select | Hub | Description: "Written by the Hub: what the daily lead pass decided. Do not edit; Redo it in the Hub." Options: Reply, Client, Spam proposed, Not now proposed, For you. P147 (decision 0055): the daily lead pass's decision for this lead, copied after each decision. Added by `hub install --only notion.lead-pass`. Not Status, which the owner and the send keep. Flags: optional. |
| Hub reason | rich_text | Hub | Description: "Written by the Hub: why the daily lead pass decided so." P147 (decision 0055): one line why the pass decided so (for For you, what the owner must do). Added by `hub install --only notion.lead-pass`. Flags: optional. |
